name: Fragment's Note -After Stories-
source:
Following the story of "Fragment's Note+"...

With the power of Miu, the girl claiming to be his daughter from the future, protagonist Yukiha manages to secure a better fate for himself.

"It's gonna be a new future from here!"

Taking Miu's words to heart, Yukiha and his chosen partner set off on their new path together. However, it seems that the journey won't be as smooth as they thought...

[From [url=https://fragmentsnote-plus-as.ullucus.com/en/]Official website[/url]]
translation:
故事接续《Fragment's Note+》……

在自称来自未来、是自己女儿的美绪力量帮助下，主角雪羽成功为自己争取到了更好的命运。

“从这里开始，将会是一个全新的未来！”

雪羽将美绪的话铭记于心，与自己选择的伙伴一起踏上新的道路。然而，这段旅程似乎并不会像他们想象的那样顺利……

[译自[url=https://fragmentsnote-plus-as.ullucus.com/en/]官方网站[/url]]
